mapper.select: SELECT cc_Time, cc_RMK FROM ( SELECT cc_Time = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Ms_Time1,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(Ms_Time1,1,2)+':' + SUBSTRING(Ms_Time1,3,2) END, cc_RMK = Ms_Remark FROM I_MySchedule WHERE Ms_date = #{searchDate} AND Ms_Flag < 50 AND (Ms_UserID = #{userId} OR Ms_Flag = 1 OR Ms_BuserID IN (SELECT Buser FROM dbo.[GetSineBuser](#{userId})) OR Ms_BuserID = #{ccBuser}) UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = SUBSTRING(Tn_time,1,2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(Tn_time,3,2), cc_RMK = tn_title FROM I_TotalNote WHERE Tn_delflag = '1' AND Tn_PlanDate = #{searchDate} UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = SUBSTRING(Ul_InTime,1,2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(Ul_InTime,3,2), cc_RMK = RTRIM(Ul_Remark) + ' ' + CASE WHEN isnull(Ul_Count,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE isnull(Ul_Count,0) + '명' END FROM I_UseList WHERE Ul_Date = #{searchDate} AND Isnull(Ul_Gongji,'N') = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = '24:00', cc_RMK = 'BirthDay : ' + Ph_Name FROM I_Phonelist LEFT JOIN I_Lunar ON ((Ph_Birthflag = '1' AND RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Ph_BirthDate,112),4) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Lu_SolarDt,112),4)) OR (Ph_Birthflag = '2' AND Lu_Yun = 0 AND RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Ph_BirthDate,112),4) = REPLACE(RIGHT(Lu_LunarDt,5),'-',''))) AND Lu_SolarDt = #{searchDate} WHERE Ph_Code = #{userId} AND Lu_SolarDt = #{searchDate} )TMP ORDER BY cc_Time

SELECT hc_Name, Du_Name = dbo.GetSaNm (Du_Code1) FROM ( SELECT Du_Flag,Du_Code1 FROM I_Duty WHERE Du_Date = CASE WHEN LEFT(CONVERT(time, GETDATE()),2) < '08' THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1, #{searchDate} ) ELSE #{searchDate} END AND Du_Flag NOT IN (9,10) UNION ALL SELECT Du_Flag = CASE WHEN Ic_Buser = '140' THEN '21' ELSE '22' END, Du_Code1 = Gu_Code1 FROM I_Gunmu LEFT JOIN P_InsaCode ON Ic_Code = Gu_Code1 WHERE Gu_Date = CASE WHEN LEFT(CONVERT(time, GETDATE()),2) < '08' THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1, #{searchDate} ) ELSE #{searchDate} END AND Ic_Jikchek = 35 AND LEFT(Gu_Flag,1) = 'N' )TMP LEFT JOIN I_HelpCD ON Hc_Code = 'Int000060' AND Hc_Seq = Du_Flag ORDER BY Hc_Filter

SELECT '오전' AS Hc_Name, ISNULL( (SELECT STRING_AGG(dbo.GetSaNm(Do_SaCD), ', ') FROM I_DocOutDuty WHERE Do_Date = #{searchDate} AND Do_AM = '1') , '') AS Du_Name UNION ALL SELECT '오후' AS Hc_Name, ISNULL( (SELECT STRING_AGG(dbo.GetSaNm(Do_SaCD), ', ') FROM I_DocOutDuty WHERE Do_Date = #{searchDate} AND Do_PM = '1') , '') AS Du_Name;
